title: Mystic Weaving Loom
description: A person's hand holds a shuttle and works on a wooden weaving loom that sits on an unrolled scroll. Golden liquid drips from the top scroll down into a pool of water below while glowing geometric shapes float in the dark background.
prompt: A detailed fantasy painting shows a person's hand holding a shuttle while working on a wooden weaving loom placed on a large unrolled scroll. Golden liquid drips from the scroll above into a pool of water below with ripples. Glowing geometric shapes float in the dark stormy background with purple and blue tones. The loom has colorful threads and a woven knot pattern visible on it.
